messages:
billing-bot: ⚠️ Payment attempt for INV-2026-0432 failed (ACH_REJECT_R20). Customer: Veridian Health. Amount: $48,720.
marcos: Ugh, R20 = non-receivable account. This usually happens for cross-border ACH or corporate accounts that block ACH. Do we have a card on file?
emily-cs: @rachel-sales customer replied — their AP team says they only allow domestic ACH to their payroll bank. They can do a wire today if we give instructions.
rachel-sales: Got it. AP contact is elliot@veridian.com. They need our full wire block + a remittance reference to reconcile. Can finance produce? We should also confirm any fees covered.
stephanie-finance: I can generate wire template. Quick Q: do we want to retry ACH with a different originator id first, or go straight to wire to avoid delays? Cutoff is EOD PST for today to reflect in March close.
marcos: No time to debug originator mapping. Let's do wire. Send template and ask them to confirm wiring today.
emily-cs: sending suggested language to customer now: "We can accept wire for immediate settlement — please send proof of payment and include invoice INV-2026-0432 in the wire reference."
rachel-sales: Also ask AP to include PO# 78934 so their AP system auto-apply.
stephanie-finance: Wire instructions (please paste into email):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Republic Bank
Address: 1 Financial Plaza, San Francisco, CA 94104
ABA (for domestic wires): 123456789
SWIFT / BIC (for international routing): FRBCUS6LXXX
Intermediary bank (if required): Bank of Global Clearing - SWIFT: BGCLUS33
Beneficiary account number: 000123456789
Beneficiary reference: INV-2026-0432 | Veridian Health | PO 78934
Notes: Please include remittance email: ap@veridian.com and attach payment confirmation PDF. Any intermediary fees should be borne by sender.
```
marcos: Perfect. Add our AP contact for remittance confirmation: payments@redwoodinference.com
emily-cs: Customer replied: "We can wire but need beneficiary tax id on paperwork — can you provide Redwood EIN?"
stephanie-finance: Redwood EIN: 27-3845592. Also include our billing address: 500 Redwood Way, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
rachel-sales: Sending to Elliot now. ETA from them?
emily-cs: Elliot said they can initiate today if we confirm instructions now. He asked whether we can accept partial wire (they'll pay 50% today, remainder by 4/5).
marcos: We should accept partial to avoid service interruption, but add a PO note and set up automatic retry for remaining balance on 4/5. @stephanie-finance ok?
stephanie-finance: OK to accept partial. I'll mark invoice as partially paid once remittance shows. Finance will schedule a reminder and a scheduled charge attempt on 4/05 for remaining $24,360.
emily-cs: Customer: "Confirm fees - we will cover intermediary fees, but not beneficiary bank fees."
marcos: Clarify: beneficiary bank fees are our fees; intermediary fees are theirs — fine.
rachel-sales: thumbs up from sales.
stephanie-finance: Final email copy I will send to customer:
---
Hi Elliot / Veridian AP —
Thanks for arranging the wire. Please use the following details and include the invoice reference: INV-2026-0432 | PO 78934. Redwood EIN: 27-3845592. Billing address: 500 Redwood Way, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
Amount today: $24,360 (partial). Remaining: $24,360 scheduled for 2026-04-05. Please attach the wire confirmation PDF to this thread or email payments@redwoodinference.com once completed. Any intermediary charges should be borne by Veridian.
Best,
Stephanie (Finance)
---
emily-cs: Sent — they acknowledged and will confirm after wire initiation. :white_check_mark:
marcos: Thanks team. I'll update accounting and set scheduled retry. If we still see rejection on retry, we'll escalate to customer engineering for originator mapping. :eyes:
